source: Installed unmodified ChimeraX 1.12 GUI registry captured 2026-10-15; metadata only, no upstream implementation.

toolbar/bs.description: Display atoms in ball and stick style

toolbar/fl.description: Show map or surface in filled style

toolbar/me.description: Show map or surface as mesh

toolbar/fm.description: Fit atomic model or map in map

toolbar/vr.description: Enable virtual reality with OpenXR.  Press to toggle passthrough video.

toolbar/xr.description: Turn OpenXR on/off for 3D flat panel displays.

toolbar/orthopick.description: Show orthogonal views of picked particles in tomograms.

toolbar/button-mm1.description: Crop volume data dragging any face of box outline

toolbar/button-mm2.description: Move plane or slab along its axis to show a different section

toolbar/button-mm3.description: Tilt image planes, hold shift key to translate

toolbar/nucleotide-slab.description: Show nucleotide bases as slabs and fill sugars

toolbar/nucleotide-box.description: Show nucleotide bases as boxes and sugars as tubes

toolbar/nucleotide-ellipsoid.description: Show nucleotide bases as ellipsoids and sugars as tubes

toolbar/nucleotide-muffler.description: Show nucleotide bases as mufflers and sugars as tubes

toolbar/mm5.description: Translate selected models, hold shift key to rotate

toolbar/mm6.description: Rotate selected models, hold shift key to translate

toolbar/mm6a.description: Move clicked-on models, hold shift key to rotate

toolbar/mm7.description: Translate selected atoms, hold shift key to rotate

toolbar/mm8.description: Rotate selected atoms, hold shift key to translate

toolbar/mm9.description: Set center of rotation at atom

toolbar/ma1.description: Toggle distance monitor between two atoms

toolbar/mc3.description: Limit display to zone around clicked residues

toolbar/mM2.description: Move plane or slab along its axis to show a different section

toolbar/mM3.description: Tilt volume planes, hold shift key to translate

toolbar/mM4.description: Crop volume data dragging any face of box outline

toolbar/mM5.description: Measure distance between two map points

toolbar/mM6.description: Measure and color connected parts of surface

toolbar/mM7.description: Erase parts of a density map setting values in a sphere to zero
